node.label: Local body polls (State ECs)
node.summary: Panchayat and municipal elections run by State Election Commissions.

facts.text: State Election Commissions are constitutional bodies under **Art. 243K** (panchayats) and **Art. 243ZA** (municipalities).
facts.plain: State Election Commissions are constitutional bodies under Art. 243K (panchayats) and Art. 243ZA (municipalities).

facts.text: Andhra Pradesh: YSRCP chief **Jagan Mohan Reddy** accused the **State Election Commission** of complicity in urban local body poll rigging; repolls were ordered in only four booths.
facts.plain: Andhra Pradesh: YSRCP chief Jagan Mohan Reddy accused the State Election Commission of complicity in urban local body poll rigging; repolls were ordered in only four booths.

facts.text: Counsel argued prohibitory orders under **Section 163 BNSS** need a real breach of peace. Section 163 replaces old CrPC **Section 144**.
facts.plain: Counsel argued prohibitory orders under Section 163 BNSS need a real breach of peace. Section 163 replaces old CrPC Section 144.

facts.text: SC (CJI **Surya Kant**, Justice **Joymalya Bagchi**) quashed the Rajasthan SEC's order barring civil-society voter awareness before **panchayat polls**: election bodies have no monopoly on voter awareness.
facts.plain: SC (CJI Surya Kant, Justice Joymalya Bagchi) quashed the Rajasthan SEC's order barring civil-society voter awareness before panchayat polls: election bodies have no monopoly on voter awareness.

facts.text: Andhra Pradesh held civic polls for 13 municipal corporations and 79 municipalities/nagar panchayats; overall turnout was **48.03%** (vs 63.30% in 2021), with Machilipatnam highest (55.10%) and Greater Visakhapatnam lowest (39.72%); YSRCP's Jagan Mohan Reddy demanded a repoll in Pulivendula alleging malpractice.

facts.text: West Bengal Congress said **1.59 lakh** names (1.20 lakh in Kolkata, 39,000 in Howrah) were deleted in the SIR ahead of civic polls; the Special Summary Revision draft roll is due **11 Nov** and final roll **16 Jan 2027**.

facts.text: Rajasthan's second phase of village panchayat polls covered **3,626** panchayats in 22 districts with **1.06 crore** voters; 45 sarpanches were elected unopposed; highest turnout **84.37%** at Rampura Dabri (Jaipur).
